## What changed

Describe the contribution and the user need it addresses.

## How it was tested

List the commands and browser checks you ran.

## Visual evidence

Add screenshots or a short recording when the contribution changes a visible interaction.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The pull request contains one focused contribution.
- [ ] I ran `npm run verify` successfully.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for material behavior.
- [ ] Keyboard, reduced motion, coarse pointer, data saver, and native cursor behavior remain usable.
- [ ] Listeners, observers, animation frames, canvases, and WebGL resources are cleaned up.
- [ ] I own or have permission to contribute every included asset under the MIT License.
- [ ] The contribution contains no credentials, private paths, client material, or unpublished personal content.
